wiki_text: The Jan 2026 Chevron/NewMed Leviathan 'Phase 1B' FID, widely reported in trade press, sanctions PIPELINE and PRODUCTION capacity expansion (additional gas export to Egypt via existing subsea pipeline infrastructure) -- it is NOT a final investment decision for the separate proposed NewMed FLNG liquefaction/export terminal at Dor, which remains at the proposed stage (2019 FEED agreements with Golar LNG and Exmar NV; no FID, EPC contract, or vessel charter as of mid-2026).
